svg.title: Clinical Research Orchestra workflow
svg.desc: Your materials go into one project folder. You plan with the agent: question (gate G1), evidence, and protocol (gate G2). Skills then analyse the data and lock the results (gate G3), write from the locked ledger, pass scripted checks and read-only reviewer agents with a revise loop of up to three rounds, and prepare the presentation and publication files. You release the deliverables at gate G4. phi-guard checks every outbound call for patient identifiers.
